title: Coin Flip
description: Coin flip app: tap to flip a coin, show a brief flip animation, then display HEADS or TAILS in large text. Show a running tally of heads and tails counts (and total flips) below. Monochrome 576x288 display.
prompts: Coin flip app: tap to flip a coin, show a brief flip animation, then display HEADS or TAILS in large text. Show a running tally of heads and tails counts (and total flips) below. Monochrome 576x288 display.
Make the coin flip spin animation last only half a second (500ms) before showing the result.
